svg.title: Summarising and labelling content
svg.desc: How is content condensed, interpreted or recast? Distinguish reducing a body of content, characterising an item, and changing representational kind. Source illustration: Audience segments become profile cards, with detailed experiences and motivations available on selection.

text.tspan: How is content condensed, interpreted or recast?
Condenses or interprets content through summaries, labels, profiles
or a change of representation, so people can grasp what it means.
